assessments.technical_explanation: The scanner matched a known advisory for a declared dependency in the lockfile. Given the project's dependency manifest, this is likely a development or build-time dependency rather than a runtime package used by the extension. Such vulnerabilities typically do not affect the final bundled extension or pose a direct risk to end users.
assessments.layman_explanation: A security issue was found in a tool used to build or test the extension. It does not appear to affect the extension itself once it is running in SillyTavern.
assessments.developer_action: Update the affected dependency to a patched version to keep the development environment secure.

assessments.technical_explanation: OSV-Scanner matched a high-severity advisory (GHSA-4c8g-83qw-93j6) against a transitive dependency in the lockfile. The project declares only yaml as a production dependency; all other declared packages are devDependencies used for webpack builds and eslint linting. Vulnerable packages in the build tooling tree do not ship in the compiled dist/index.js output that end users load, limiting runtime exposure to the development environment.
assessments.layman_explanation: A known security issue was found in a tool used to build this extension, not in the extension itself. The problem affects developers building from source, not people using the finished extension.
assessments.developer_action: Update affected dev dependencies to patched versions to keep the build environment current.
